_note: Single source for every price shown on / and in the console Plans panel. DRAFT numbers marked draft:true are placeholders for Tom to confirm.
promise: Pay only for what you use

pack.name: Starter pack
includes: Your voice cloned, so it sounds like you
Your prices, hours and emergency rules loaded
Your phone set to send missed calls to it, and a test call together
Urgent calls texted to you straight away, everything else in a 7am email

usage.name: Answering calls
usage.example: 40 missed calls a month at 2 minutes each is about £40

addons.name: Website
addons.what: A simple site for your business, with the same receptionist in its chat. Google and ChatGPT can read it.

addons.name: Your own web address and email
addons.what: yourname.co.uk and you@yourname.co.uk. We charge what it costs us, nothing on top.

addons.name: After-call agent
addons.what: After each call it texts the customer a summary, sends your quote or booking details, and asks happy customers for a Google review.

addons.name: WhatsApp agent
addons.what: Answers questions and booking requests on your WhatsApp. Anything urgent comes straight to you.

addons.name: Email agent
addons.what: Replies to enquiries on your email within your rules, and drafts anything tricky for you to approve.

addons.name: Diary sync
addons.what: Offers customers your real free times. It only sees busy or free, never your personal details.

addons.name: Bookings from ChatGPT and AI assistants
addons.what: When someone asks ChatGPT for a local tradesperson, it can check your times and request a booking. You still confirm.
